title: BoardPrep Batch 652 LET closure and CSE source-readiness foundation

currentness.let_basis: Narrow official PRC search confirmed no controlling source change affecting the exact four Batch651 plans; Batch649 scope research not repeated.
currentness.scope_summary: CSC 2026 detailed announcement names General Information, Verbal, Analytical, Numerical and Subprofessional Clerical; 2027 calendar defers the specific scope to a later individual announcement. No official weights found.
currentness.future_effective_scope: CY2027 individual announcement pending; quarantine changes until published.

repeat_risk.basis: High native volume is concentrated in a small number of leaves; stored family labels are sparse. Four bounded propositions survived review; balance is not a quota.

scope_blockers.reason: The repository places this leaf under Analytical Ability, while the controlling CSC 2026 scope names number sequence under Numerical Ability; do not authorize this placement until an official crosswalk resolves the area conflict.

cse.decision_reason: Three true zero leaves and two additional leaves have concrete, bounded unused propositions after source/study review. The remaining deficits are not a numeric quota; batch production should re-evaluate the contingent Wave2 after Wave1 QA. An apparent number-sequence candidate is quarantined because the repository area conflicts with the controlling CSC scope.

warning_reconciliation.note: Threshold findings nest (a zero leaf can also be under5, under10, and under20); they are not 1009 unique board defects. Health uses native ownership counts; CSE shared flat rows explain its largest native/effective mismatch.
